items.title: createPaymentAccountHolderStep
items.description: This step creates the account holder in the payment provider.

items.title: createPaymentSessionStep
items.description: This step creates a payment session.

items.title: createRefundReasonStep
items.description: This step creates one or more refund reasons.

items.title: deletePaymentSessionsStep
items.description:
This step deletes one or more payment sessions.

Note: This step should not be used alone as it doesn't consider a revert
Use [deletePaymentSessionsWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/deletePaymentSessionsWorkflow) instead, which uses this step.

items.title: deleteRefundReasonsStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more refund reasons.

items.title: updatePaymentCollectionStep
items.description: This step updates payment collections matching the specified filters.

items.title: updateRefundReasonsStep
items.description: This step updates one or more refund reasons.

items.title: validateDeletedPaymentSessionsStep
items.description:
This step validates that the specified payment session IDs were deleted.
If not all payment sessions were deleted, the step throws an error.
